children: According to Sina Finance, the UK Maritime Trade Operations office received reports that multiple merchant ships in the northern Arabian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman were hit by firepower capable of disabling vessels as part of ongoing military activity in the region. The office said it could not yet confirm whether there were any casualties or environmental damage.

title: UK Maritime Agency Reports Multiple Merchant Ships Hit in Arabian Gulf and Gulf of Oman
